purpose: Guided operator setup for Tesla OAuth, Fleet token refresh, VIN telemetry subscription, domain/public-key readiness and streaming confirmation.
primaryGoal: Connect Tesla, configure one locally selected VIN using existing Fleet APIs, and verify independently sourced setup and telemetry health without losing advanced controls.

scope.mountedRouteEvidence: web\src\App.tsx:322 lazy import; :636 SafeRoute registration. Mounting in a running browser was not exercised.

dataSources.behavior: Shared ['auth-status'] query; cancellation signal forwarded. deriveDataState distinguishes initial failure from retained refresh failure. Query defaults are inherited.

Separate fleetSetupKeys, select normalizers, cancellation, reference query policy. The reference tier uses 30-minute staleTime and no mount/focus/reconnect refetch at web\src\api\queryPolicy.ts:165-176. Keep raw contracts and existing policy; report cross-source invalidation gaps rather than changing cache semantics casually.

['onboarding','status']; 30-second polling continues after durable setup, 15-second staleTime, retry 2, cancellation. Normalizer preserves setup_complete/is_complete compatibility and healthy/stale/unknown telemetry health. Gate defaults are intentionally pessimistic, not measured values.

['vehicles'] cache, safeArray list normalization and cancellation. Wake requiresLiveMode and networkMode always at :352-364. VIN is a local configuration target, not a second analysis-workspace selector.

Trimmed, encoded VIN in key and URL; enabled only for nonempty VIN. Operational query policy, forwarded cancellation, config summary and error payload normalization. Independent source failures have retries.

Live-only, networkMode always, existing toasts and invalidateAndBroadcast for VIN config/errors and onboarding. Optional host, port, PEM CA, field list, interval_seconds and field_intervals. Preserve Tesla field identifiers literally; they are not display measurements.

OAuth URL guard and navigation; confirmation before disconnect; auth/vehicle broadcast invalidation; sync is live-only. Disconnect is sudo/non-impersonation guarded server-side. Do not bypass challenge handling in request().

Existing signal catalog supplies category and exact vendor field names. Modal search, eight presets, master/category/per-signal intervals, selection, expansion and reopen reseeding. No fixture data or measured SI conversion is involved.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: IconBox + title + HelperText panel heading repeats across the guide, progress, subscribe and streaming panels. Existing primitives are already reused.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Use existing layout/typography composition; do not invent a FleetCard or new global panel-heading wrapper on evidence from only this page.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Progress uses onboarding Stepper while Guide uses OrderedStepList. They look related but their action visibility and progress policies differ.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep static and live instruction semantics distinct. Reuse OrderedStepList only through an explicit adapter that preserves Stepper's first-pending CTA and localized status; no speculative extraction.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Repeated ternary mapping from DataState to SourceState appears in the page and domain panels.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Retain deriveDataState and SourceContent. A scoped adapter may reduce duplication but must not discard refreshError, paused state, source identity or last-success timestamps.

issues.detail: Category row simultaneously contains toggle, expanding heading/count and interval select; signal rows truncate identifiers (:364), and footer uses non-wrapping justify-between (:385). Crowding and inaccessible full names are source risks at 320px/200% text, not demonstrated overflow.
issues.fix: Reflow category/footer controls, wrap or provide accessible full signal labels, keep every selection/interval action and persistent footer reachable. Exercise all ten widths plus open-dialog scrolling.

issues.detail: Fingerprint and well-known path are unbounded source strings rendered through KVList. The caller does not demonstrate long-string wrapping.
issues.fix: Verify existing KVList wrap behavior with long fingerprint/path values before changing its owner; preserve full values.

Connection status uses role=status/aria-live; Stepper uses aria-current and VisuallyHidden localized states.

issues.detail: Progress CTAs call scrollIntoView with unconditional behavior=smooth and do not move focus to the target. Visual scrolling alone may leave keyboard focus at the old CTA.
issues.fix: Use existing motion preference and respect reduced motion; deliberately focus an existing accessible destination heading/control without adding a second focus system. Preserve the three target IDs.

issues.detail: Interval description labels and preset names/descriptions (:29-88) are hardcoded English; preset descriptions rely on title (:253). Raw buttons have custom focus/target chrome rather than the canonical Button. Raw HTML inside shared UI is not itself a page raw-HTML violation.
issues.fix: Use current shared Button/selection/typography primitives, localized display labels and keyboard-accessible help while retaining exact category/field identities and preset calculations.

issues.detail: Panel Shield icon lacks aria-hidden while neighboring domain panel icons explicitly hide decorative SVGs.
issues.fix: Hide this purely decorative cue, retaining localized heading and action names; verify actual accessibility tree rather than assuming announcement behavior.

states.initialLoading: SourceContent suppresses unresolved bodies with skeletons; KPI per-source sourceLoading avoids hiding resolved neighboring sources.
states.empty: No account/vehicles, no VIN/config, waiting/stale stream and missing public key have explanatory content. Guide and advanced help remain visible.
states.fatalError: Independent SourceContent errors/retry for auth, vehicles, token, onboarding, public key, VIN config and errors; no single all-page data gate.
states.retainedRefresh: deriveDataState keeps data on failed/paused refresh. Root aggregates retained status and local bodies show retained warnings/retry.
states.mutation: Subscribe/unsubscribe/wake share busy gating; remove/disconnect require confirmation; auth and sync preserve toasts/pending feedback.

issues.rule: MDC-026/unknown is not a negative result
issues.detail: Progress receives authenticated === true and no source state. Missing/failing auth becomes false; missing token/telemetry also becomes incomplete. It renders a definitive 0/4 and actionable first step while sources are unresolved or failed.
issues.fix: Pass known/loading/retained/error provenance to the local progress adapter and represent unresolved checks explicitly; retain all four steps and working CTAs when prerequisites are known.

issues.detail: Subscribe completion is inferred from historical fleet-wide last_telemetry_at/data_flowing, not selected-VIN telemetry config. This is existing heuristic evidence, not proof the currently selected VIN is subscribed.
issues.fix: Make the historical/fleet-wide meaning explicit, or use a proven selected-VIN config source through the existing hook without conflating durable setup with current configuration. Do not invent backend subscription health.

issues.detail: State adapters map paused retained queries and failed refresh to the same retained state; fatalError alone is forwarded, omitting refreshError/updatedAt/isRefreshBlocked. Root header query list also omits auth (:52).
issues.fix: Use existing retainedMessage and source context to distinguish refresh failure/offline and expose last success; include auth in freshness metadata where appropriate without hiding healthy sources.

issues.detail: Account action row is outside SourceContent; missing auth during loading/fatal failure selects the connect CTA rather than an unresolved prerequisite presentation.
issues.fix: Keep the row reachable but identify unresolved auth and avoid presenting unknown as a confirmed disconnected account. Do not remove recovery/re-authorization access.

visualIssues.detail: Five fleet setup panel headings plus account use decorative cyan/green/purple/blue IconBoxes. IconBox applies neonColorMap bg/ring/text, whose neon surfaces/rings are defined at tokens.ts:21-26. No glow is applied by IconBox itself.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing neutral surface-2, border-default ring and text-secondary class overrides for decorative headings, following OrderedStepList.tsx:86. Reserve subdued semantic success/warning/danger for actual state, not domains. No new palette and no persisted theme-ID reset.

visualIssues.detail: Mounted shared picker retains fixed-white surface/border overlays, neon-cyan hover/selection/fill (:264-266,320,359,397), neon text interval (:9), tiny ad-hoc uppercase typography and opacity-40 inactive rows (:356). Its tokens do not establish measured contrast.
visualIssues.fix: Replace white overlays with existing surface/border variables; use canonical Button and semantic selection chrome, theme-aware primary/secondary/muted text and typography roles. Keep selection checked/pressed states and use subdued selected accents; no new glow. Keep preference-driven chart colors unchanged.

visualIssues.detail: Current indicator uses cyan-500/20 and cyan-400/50, completed green line at :150, and an ongoing spinner at :140 even when no request is in flight. Reduced-motion class is already present.
visualIssues.fix: Keep completed/current/pending semantics and localized status; neutralize structure/connector, retain restrained success/current emphasis and use a static current-step indicator when not actually busy.

visualIssues.detail: Connection body and sync outcome text use direct emerald/rose-300 (:134,159,203) rather than semantic text roles. Source uses toned-down colors, not pure-white; actual light/dark composed contrast is unknown.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing theme-aware semantic status tokens/Badge plus normal typography for descriptions; preserve explicit connection/outcome wording and expiry warning.

architectureIssues.detail: Feature directly imports SignalConfigModal concrete module; account section similarly directly imports feedback/Toast at :11.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing category barrel if exported; otherwise request an integration-owner export. Do not create a replacement modal/toast.

architectureIssues.detail: Shared picker imports Input, Modal and Select from its own UI barrel, contrary to shared concrete-module import policy.
architectureIssues.fix: Use concrete existing internal module imports in the shared owner's change, with focused modal regression and centralized chunk-cycle acceptance.

architectureIssues.detail: Auth refresh/disconnect invalidate only authStatus. Fleet API info is a separate 30-minute reference query used to classify token and account; no invalidation connects these mutations to fleetSetupKeys.apiInfo. KPI can still say connected/auto-refresh after auth changes until that source refreshes.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner should coordinate narrowly scoped invalidation/refetch of the existing Fleet info source after auth mutations and preserve all existing keys/broadcasts. No independent polling or query store.

architectureIssues.detail: Picker permits interval 0 labelled 500ms, but when the first returned signal has interval 0 the panel sets masterInterval=0 (:361), omits interval_seconds (:124), and excludes fields equal to master from field_intervals (:111). Hook also requires interval_seconds > 0. Source proves omission, not how the backend interprets it.
architectureIssues.fix: Before modernization, pin the existing server interpretation and a focused zero-interval payload regression. Preserve all sampling choices and raw seconds; do not silently reinterpret zero, remove 500ms, or invent an SI adapter.

architectureIssues.detail: Fleet bool normalizer returns false for absent/malformed fields (:53-55); telemetry error normalizer returns [] for unrecognized shapes (:172-181). A successful malformed response can look like missing token/key or no Tesla-side errors.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner should pin valid response envelopes and distinguish parse-unavailable from known negative/empty while preserving query keys, cancellation and raw payload contracts. Do not guess backend capabilities.

actions: Four progress CTAs targeting fleet-setup-account, fleet-setup-subscribe and fleet-setup-stream
Change master/category/per-signal intervals including existing 500ms choice
dataBehavior: Independent auth/Fleet info/public key/onboarding reads and retained payloads must survive.

Fleet setup has no global analysis range: workspaceScope RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS excludes this route; /settings disables header vehicle picker. Preserve local subscription VIN; do not add scope=local or a second date range.
Keep cancellation signals, existing query keys/policies, continued onboarding polling, source recovery and broadcast invalidation.

Preserve raw SI wire/cache contracts; sampling interval_seconds remains seconds. Tesla vendor identifiers such as ChargeRateMilePerHour/MilesToArrival are upstream names, not permission to convert or rename signals.
Keep live-only mutation boundaries, request sudo/auth handling and destructive confirmations. Do not perform actual writes during acceptance without explicit safe environment authority.
Preserve OAuth malformed-URL guard and teslasync auth-expired/recovered event listeners/recovery edge logic.
Keep token expiry warning calculations, source timestamps, count semantics, host/port/default CA explanations and public-key versus command-key distinction.
Existing telemetry errors view renders first three errors only; preserve at least existing visibility and messages, do not claim full error history.
Do not silently drop presets, signals, individual sampling rates or advanced fields while restraining palette.
